Name: Nyapu Style Roronoa Zoro
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Zoro is done! Goodness, he had a ton of expressions. I hope you all like him. I referenced a bunch of Zoro's images to get his outfits right. I am glad I get to add another Husbando to my game. Zoro was another NPC that was voted on by my social media sites. Only a few more to go. I hope you all look forward to them. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][Main File] CP is just a drag-and-drop into your mods folder. 

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. There are two versions. Pick the one that corresponds to the sprites you choose. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page.  [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The Main CP file lets you choose between two portrait types that match either the Original or Anubskorpiak sprite designs.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]You will, of course, need the main mod, plus some accompanying frameworks. [/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6316]Custom NPC - Roronoa Zoro[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] (Optional if you want to change the portraits. Highly recommended)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. [/i]
[i]Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56819057]EmpressKimi[/url]  for allowing me to retexture your mod[/i]
[i]Thank you earthtosyd for giving me your living portrait frame edit.  [/i] [/color]
